title: Normalized pure sections generate the affine iterated pullback sections.
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module, $U,W$ affine objects of its small etale site, $g:W\to U$ a morphism, and $n\in\mathbf N$. Put $P=W\times_U\cdots\times_U W$ with $n+1$ factors, $M=\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)$, and $\rho:M\to\Gamma(P,P^*\mathcal F)$ the unit-normalized tensor restriction of [new-etale-affine-singleton-tensor-degree-comparison-hom-normalization]. Then the sections $(\prod_k\pi_k^*b_k)\rho(m)$, for $m\in M$ and $b_k\in\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)$, generate the additive group $\Gamma(P,P^*\mathcal F)$.

source.place: Tag 03P2, affine tensor calculation, using Tags 01I4, 01JQ, 01I9, 01IA

proof.text: Put A=Gamma(U,O), B=Gamma(W,O), M=Gamma(U,u*F), and P equal to the product of n+1 copies of W over U. Iterate the binary affine fibre-product spectrum formula. The projection equations identify the indexed tensor inclusions with pullbacks along P to W. Thus P is affine and its ring of sections is the indexed tensor power of B over A.

The pullback u*F is quasi-coherent. Compare tensor pullback with ordinary pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints to the same pushforward, and transport this property along that isomorphism. Apply affine pullback sections to P to U and this coefficient module. Compose with the unit-normalized composition isomorphism used to define the etale tensor-section restriction. Tensoring the ring identification with M produces an additive equivalence E to Gamma(P,P*F), whose value on m tensor tprod(b) is the product of the projection pullbacks of b_i times the normalized restriction of m.

TensorProduct.induction_on and PiTensorProduct.induction_on express every tensor as a sum of m tensor tprod(b), moving scalars to m by balancing. The affine sections isomorphism sends these tensors to the displayed generators, so their additive closure is the whole section group.

theorem singletonTensorSections_span
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (hU : IsAffine U.left) (hW : IsAffine W.left)
    (n : ℕ) :
    let P := ∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g)
    AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range (fun p :
      Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤) × (Fin (n + 1) → Γ(W.left, ⊤)) ↦
        (∏ k : Fin (n + 1),
          (Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g) k).left.left.appTop (p.2 k)) •
            Modules.etaleTensorSectionsRestriction F P.hom p.1)) = ⊤
